No measurements yet, so there is no summary to show. Once a run on the canonical dataset
has been recorded, this section carries one table: a row per kind of test and physical
field, with the number of axes it covers, the per-frame rank correlation with severity,
the weakest separation between neighbouring severity levels, the damage reached at the
strongest severity, and the severity at which the metric first departs from clean. The
canaries appear as their own rows, showing the damage assigned to the phase-randomised
impostor and to an unrelated field.

The table reports what was measured and does not grade it. What the numbers mean for this
metric is in `## Results`, beside the test that produced each one.

Run

    python -m fmeval.cards evidence rmse --results results/<run>

to generate it.
